text:
We’ve all felt it: that suffocating sensation when your digital calendar looks less like a schedule and more like a battlefield. When every hour is accounted for, you lose the mental space to actually think.

If you’re feeling the squeeze, try this beginner habit: schedule "white space" blocks. Every Tuesday and Thursday, block out 30 minutes of non-negotiable, empty time. Don't label it "admin" or "catch up"—just leave it blank. It’s a small way to reclaim your agency and breathe.
